purpose: Materialize the complete Hero -> ordered Skin reverse index for all 267 canonical Heroes by inverting the accepted 540-edge Stage 2-1 Skin -> Hero relation without reopening raw ConfigData ownership semantics.

recordShape.skinIds: integer[] / zero-or-many Skin foreign keys ordered by ascending frozen sourceOrder

orderingRule: Within each Hero entry, skinIds must be ordered by ascending sourceOrder from the accepted Stage 2-1 forward relation. sourceOrder itself is not copied into the reverse-index consumer record.
prohibitions: Do not read raw ConfigData or Hero Stage 5-5 as a new ownership or ordering source.
Do not omit Heroes with zero regular skins; all 267 canonical heroIds must have one reverse-index entry.
Do not re-sort skinIds by skinId, name, Score, UISort, release state, acquisition metadata, filename or asset path.
Do not introduce releaseStatus, displayTarget, KR_FUTURE, localization, acquisition or asset-export fields.
Do not synthesize or renumber sourceOrder values.
completionRule: 2-2 completes only when exactly 267 canonical Hero entries are emitted, exactly 235 contain one-or-more skinIds, exactly 32 contain an empty skinIds array, the reverse index contains exactly the same 540 Skin -> Hero edges as Stage 2-1, and every per-Hero skinIds list preserves ascending Stage 2-1 sourceOrder.
nextAction: Skin 2-3: prove full forward/reverse relation parity and publish the accepted bidirectional relation checkpoint for downstream consumers.
